subject: Recap: Tuesday discovery — timeline, risks, and signoff owners
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@corlix.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@corlix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Recap: Tuesday discovery — timeline, risks, and signoff owners

Hi Aisha / Ravi —

Thanks again for a focused discovery session today. Quick recap so we’re all aligned and can hand this to procurement and your engineering sponsor: 

Key pain & goals we heard
- Search relevancy is regressing after recent catalog changes; false positives in category mapping.
- Peak inference cost is blocking nightly indexing and real-time personalization.
- Primary goal: reduce tail-latency to <= 120ms 95th percentile and cut per-token cost by ~30% on the personalization pipeline.

Constraints / must-haves
- Data residency: all inference logs retained in Corlix VPC for 90 days (security team requirement).
- No code changes to the upstream microservice this quarter; must be transparent to existing API.
- Production SLA target: 99.9% uptime for inference endpoints.

Next steps we agreed (open items in bold)
1) Redwood to share a concise acceptance calendar with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria — attached. (Deliver: Tessa — by Wed 4/4)
2) Corlix to confirm internal decision owner and procurement timeline — Aisha / Ravi (Action: please confirm by Thu 4/5)
3) Technical deep-dive with Corlix infra owner to validate KV cache feasibility (tentative: week of 4/9) — (Action: Jonas to propose times)
4) Procurement: preliminary SOW template and preferred billing model (monthly vs committed) — Marissa to send draft after calendar is confirmed.

Attachment: corlix-discovery-notes.pdf (high-level call notes) and proposed-acceptance-calendar.csv (milestone dates + owners).

If any item above is incorrect or missing, please flag and I’ll update the calendar. Otherwise we’ll consider the calendar the working source of truth and iterate.

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0192
--
Redwood Inference | Make inference predictable
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@corlix.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@corlix.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Tuesday discovery — timeline, risks, and signoff owners

Thanks Tessa — clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Decision owners:
   - Executive sponsor: Ravi Menon (VP Product) — final signoff on business KPIs
   - Procurement lead: Me (Aisha) — contracting, budget intake week of 4/16
   - Infra/tech owner for trial: Sameer Gupta (cc’d on this thread separately) — will confirm availability for the week of 4/9.

2) Timeline nuance: procurement run starts 4/16, but we can run a short (2-week) technical pilot in a non-prod bucket earlier if Redwood accepts reduced sampling (we can provide a masked catalog slice). That would accelerate verification of latency/cost claims.

3) Security: Our security team requires a short SOC 2 questions doc and confirmation that logs are encrypted in transit and at rest. If Redwood has a one-page compliance summary we can attach to the procurement packet, that will speed things up.

I’ll loop Sameer into the technical scheduling thread by EOD. For now we’re happy to proceed with the acceptance calendar as the working plan.

—Aisha
Sr. Director, Platform Engineering | Corlix Technologies
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@corlix.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 02:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Tuesday discovery — timeline, risks, and signoff owners

Aisha — thanks for the clarity on owners and procurement timing. Per Tessa’s note, I’ve updated the attached acceptance calendar to reflect Corlix’s decision gates and acceptance criteria. Summary of the updated milestones (also in CSV):

• Milestone A — Pilot kickoff (non-prod, masked catalog)
  Owner: Sameer Gupta (Corlix)
  Target start: 2028-04-09
  Acceptance: end-to-end latency verification under 120ms 95th, sample cost reduction >=20%

• Milestone B — Production pilot & security review
  Owner: Aisha Patel (Procurement)
  Target start: 2028-04-16
  Acceptance: SOC 2 Q&A completed, logs encryption confirmed, legal signoff on data residency appendix

• Milestone C — Executive review & go/no-go
  Owner: Ravi Menon (Exec Sponsor)
  Target date: 2028-05-02
  Acceptance: Business KPI delta and projected unit-cost savings approved

Open risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Catalog slice may not surface tail latency patterns — Mitigation: run two different slices (user-focused + random sample) during pilot.
- Risk: Procurement delay — Mitigation: parallelize SOC 2 Q&A with pilot to avoid blocking the technical verification.

I’ve attached the updated proposed-acceptance-calendar.csv and corlix-discovery-notes.pdf to this message for your packet. Marissa (Customer Success) will draft an SOW-lite for review once you sign off on the dates.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@corlix.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@corlix.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Tuesday discovery — timeline, risks, and signoff owners

Appreciate the crisp calendar — that reads well. I’m happy to be the exec sponsor and will plan for the 5/2 review. Two quick asks before we kick the pilot: 

1) Please send the one-page security/compliance summary Aisha requested (SOC 2 scope, encryption posture, data handling).
2) If Redwood can support a short runbook for the trial (how rollback/fallthrough works and who to call for throttling/fallback), that will reduce our infra team’s hesitation.

If those two are in place, I’ll greenlight internal communications and get finance to prep a fast-track PO process for May.

Ravi
VP Product | Corlix Technologies
